slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
A little wobble on the way to the loo at night, and Koko started skipping the daily walk.

Balance isn't something you simply lose with age. It's a skill, and it responds to practice. Research suggests regular exercise can reduce falls in older adults.

Hybi's 1-minute habits: hold the bench and lift one foot while the kettle boils, 10–30 seconds each side, then fingertips only. Stand from a chair with no hands, 10 times, once or twice a day. Light the hallway at night and ditch the loose rugs.

A recent fall, dizziness when you stand, or new weakness in the legs is worth a chat with your GP or physio. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐨

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
